mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.employee_id as employeeId, e.real_name as employeeName, e.avatar, a.ATTENDANCE_DATE, a.status FROM attendance a LEFT JOIN employee e ON a.employee_id = e.id
AND a.employee_id = #{employeeId}
AND e.real_name LIKE '%' || #{employeeName} || '%'
AND TRUNC(a.ATTENDANCE_DATE) = TRUNC(#{date,jdbcType=DATE})
AND a.status = #{status}
AND TRUNC(a.ATTENDANCE_DATE) >= TRUNC(#{startDate,jdbcType=DATE})
AND TRUNC(a.ATTENDANCE_DATE)<= TRUNC(#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE})
ORDER BY a.ATTENDANCE_DATE DESC, a.employee_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance SET status = #{status}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
